actions.title: Ask for the reconciliation to be finished
actions.description: Sends a short message, by the business's alert channel, to the people who can reconcile the bank, asking them to finish the reconciliation that has been open too long.
actions.plain: Asks the people who can reconcile the bank to finish a reconciliation that has been open too long.
actions.example: The main account's reconciliation has been open 41 days. The finance team gets a reminder.
actions.who_approves: Someone allowed to manage alerts (for example the owner or a finance manager)

actions.title: Remind the reviewers
actions.description: Sends a short message to the people who can work through the exceptions inbox.
actions.plain: Reminds the people who work through the exceptions inbox that items have been waiting too long.
actions.example: 11 items have waited more than a week. The reviewers get a reminder.
actions.who_approves: Someone allowed to manage alerts (for example the owner or a finance manager)

actions.title: Remind whoever can decide
actions.description: Sends a short message, by the business's alert channel, to the people who can approve the leave request or the payroll run that has been waiting too long.
actions.plain: Reminds the person who can decide that a leave request or a payroll run has been waiting too long. It sends a short message and decides nothing.
actions.example: A leave request has waited 8 days. The branch's approver gets a reminder.

for_checks.title: Payroll not finished after the pay date

actions.who_approves: Someone allowed to manage alerts (for example the owner or a finance manager)

actions.title: Hold the customer's credit
actions.description: Lowers the customer's credit limit to what they owe now, through the customers' credit-change flow, so no more can be sold to them on account until they pay. Always needs a person.
actions.plain: Lowers a late customer's credit limit to what they already owe, so nothing more can be sold to them on account until they pay. It always needs a person, because credit is money.
actions.example: Customer C is 60 days late. Ziira proposes dropping the limit from 200,000 to the 150,000 they owe.

for_checks.title: Credit given to a customer who was overdue

actions.who_approves: Someone allowed to change customers' credit

actions.title: Remind the customer to pay
actions.description: Sends the business's usual payment reminder (by SMS, email or a chat channel, as set in the company's reminder channel) about the customer's oldest overdue invoices. Customers who asked not to be contacted are not messaged.
actions.plain: Sends your usual payment reminder to a customer who is late, about their oldest overdue invoices (at most three). Customers who asked not to be contacted are never messaged.
actions.example: Customer A is 45 days late on two invoices. A reminder goes out by SMS or email, the way you normally remind customers.
actions.who_approves: Someone allowed to manage what customers owe (for example a branch manager or an accountant)

actions.title: Draft a purchase request
actions.description: Makes a draft request to buy the product for the branch, for the usual supplier, in the quantity needed to get back to the reorder level or a month's sales, whichever is more. A person sends it.
actions.plain: When a product has run out or is low at a branch, Ziira writes a draft purchase request: enough to get back to your reorder level or cover a month of sales, whichever is more. Your usual suppliers are noted on it. Nothing is ordered until a person sends it.
actions.example: Cement is out of stock at Branch A. Ziira drafts a request for 120 bags and notes the two suppliers you buy from most.
actions.who_approves: Someone allowed to create purchase requests for that branch

actions.title: Update the selling price
actions.description: Sets a new tax-inclusive selling price on the default price list, from tomorrow, that gives the new cost the margin the product had before. Always needs a person: a price is money.
actions.plain: When a supplier raises a cost and your margin shrinks, Ziira works out a new selling price that gives the new cost the same margin the old cost had. It takes effect from tomorrow, and only after a person approves.
actions.example: Cement now costs 17% more. Ziira proposes raising the price from 850 to 975 so the margin stays at 12%.
actions.who_approves: Someone allowed to change selling prices
